scope: Bind transitive external compiler header inputs for the controlled semantic-adapter routes without promoting qualification or claiming complete toolchain closure.

method.kind: Primary CMake/GCC documentation plus isolated local builder and runner self-tests

sources.finding: CMake emits exact compiler calls for translation units when enabled; support is limited to Makefile and Ninja generators, and unity builds are not well supported.
-M outputs dependencies for included files, including -include and -imacros inputs; -MM omits system headers and their descendants.
-print-prog-name queries a compiler-selected subprocess such as cpp, and -print-file-name reports the selected file when resolvable.
GCC is a driver that selects and invokes subprocesses using spec strings; a specs file can change which subprocesses run and which options they receive.

method.localBuildValidation: Synthetic isolated CMake project with one library and one adapter executable; a known external header is observed and a post-build content change is rejected.

implementation.supportedCaptureProfile: single-config POSIX GNU/Clang/AppleClang; CMake Makefile/Ninja compile database; actual codemodel translation units only
implementation.capturedInputs: Transitive headers outside the immutable package snapshot and fresh build directory, recorded with absolute path, byte size, and SHA-256 before compilation and rechecked after build.
implementation.gccReportedSubprograms: The GCC CMake profile additionally records content identities for driver-reported cc1plus, as, collect2, lto-wrapper, and an external specs file when GCC returns an exact absolute path. Bare names are left unbound instead of being resolved through the host PATH.
implementation.pairComparison: Build-profile core must match; common external dependency paths must retain identical content. Different source revisions may legitimately reach different external header sets.
unavailableCases: Windows Make depfile grammar is not qualified
multi-config compile databases are not qualified
unrecognized compiler families do not use this dependency scan
existing builds without a pre-build scan remain unavailable
GCC subprograms/specs that are not reported as exact absolute files remain unbound

limitations: This records reached external headers, not the full installed SDK/sysroot tree or compiler configuration files.
GCC driver subprograms are best-effort only; resource binaries and subprocesses without an absolute driver-reported path remain unbound.
A reported GCC specs file is hashed as one file; any files it references through specs include directives are not recursively enumerated.
Linker inputs, dynamic library resolution, and native Windows/MSVC developer-environment inputs remain unbound.
The shared-path check is a content consistency control, not an independent semantic support vote.
This macOS run exercised the AppleClang build path and mocked GCC path-resolution contracts; it did not execute a native GNU/Linux GCC build.
nextGate: Bind compiler runtime/resource/config inputs, the selected SDK/sysroot, and actual link closure; add native GNU and MSVC profile validation. Keep implicitConfiguration partial and paired receipts ineligible until every input in the admitted profile is closed.
